name: token-drift-checker
description: Detects design token drift after code push

onFailure.message:
⚠️ WARNING: Design token drift detected!

🎨 Token Mismatch Found:
  - Figma Tokens JSON ≠ Tailwind Config / tokens.css
  - Design system synchronization required

📊 Drift Report:
  See: ./.token-drift-report.json

🔧 To fix:
  1. Review drift report for specific mismatches
  2. Update Tailwind config or Figma tokens
  3. Run: /run sync-tokens (if available)
  4. Re-commit synchronized tokens

💡 Tip: Keep design tokens in sync to maintain design system integrity

onSuccess.message: ✅ Token Drift Check: All design tokens synchronized
